[[Tin Dao Kaineng]] is a [[Naga]] [[ritualist]] [[boss]].

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Haiju Lagoon}} (On [[Yuroso Island]])

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Spirit Burn}}
*{{skill icon|Spirit Rift}}
*{{skill icon|Union}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Monstrous Claw]]
*[[Naga Pelt]]
*[[Naga Trappings]]
*[[Tin Dao's Staff]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
*In [[hard mode]], he's very dangerous due to Spirit Rift. Without proper flagging of heroes, he can wipe your party in seconds. Consider bringing [[Pain Inverter]] to quickly dispatch this boss. He is sometimes not visible because he is perched on his mountain.

==Trivia==
*He uses the same model as a Jade Sea Naga caster, instead of a Shing Jea Island Naga caster.
*"Kaineng" means "Emperor" in [[Language#Old Canthan|Canthan]], making his name Tin Dao Emperor.
